results.title: Jinx
results.overview: Three years ago she stole a secret worth killing for. And now that she's back, this thief for hire has his own reasons for revenge. But just how far can he trust her?

results.title: Tumšā robeža
results.overview: A historical thriller about Latvia in 1938 - not long before the Russian occupation.

results.title: De berg
results.overview: Isabel, thirty-ish and beyond happy, is approached by a secretive firm. The offer? To disappear and start all over again. She laughs it off. It's an absurd suggestion, a joke - right up until her life starts falling apart.

results.title: Bread of Hope
results.overview: The life of Nazan, who runs the small town bakery "Tatlı Maya" (Bread of Hope) all on her own, changes when a young Syrian woman named Rana walks through her door. Already in labor, Rana gives birth to her baby inside the bakery. Having lost her husband, been evicted from her home, and left with nowhere else to go, Rana is taken in by Nazan—first into her own home, and later into the bakery. As a quiet bond forms between the two women amidst the rhythms of daily life, rumors begin to spread and intensify throughout the town. Fueled in part by Sami—a man who has long harbored an interest in Nazan—these prejudices lead customers to abandon the bakery, eventually resulting in the authorities sealing off "Tatlı Maya" on the grounds that Rana was being employed there illegally. Nazan begins to pay a heavy price for the decision she made.

results.title: Kuzma: Extremely Happy
results.overview: Through exclusive archival footage and never before seen home video, this documentary aims to explore the real face of Andriy Viktorovych Kuzmenko (Kuzma Skryabin), the father of the contemporary Ukrainian rock and roll scene.

results.title: Paper Daughter
results.overview: A young Chinese woman grapples with the guilt of using the identity of a deceased girl to immigrate to the United States via Angel Island in 1926.

results.title: Judaa
results.overview: A young man sacrifices his chance at love to preserve a cherished friendship. When loss reshapes their lives, he carries forward an unfulfilled dream of universal education, keeping alive the memory of the woman who inspired it.

results.title: Wounds
results.overview: Caleb, a young SFX makeup artist struggles to create realistic effects until he witnesses a brutal murder. Intrigued by what he saw, he descends into a psychological abyss as he takes on extreme measures to create his masterful effects.

results.title: Benvenuto Cellini
results.overview: Rome, 1532. Pope Clement VII has tasked the sculptor Benvenuto Cellini with creating a bronze statue of Perseus before the end of carnival. Seeking fame and fortune, the latter accepts the commission, even though his workshop is short on both time and metal. On top of that, Cellini is head over heels in love with Teresa, the daughter of the Pope’s treasurer, Balducci, who for his part is intent on marrying his daughter to Fieramosca, Cellini’s rival in love and art. When the young lovers’ attempt to elope fails, Cellini has no choice but to carry out his task successfully if he wants to avoid certain death…  Alain Altinoglu is the ideal conductor for this richly coloured masterpiece, to be staged for the first time at La Monnaie. Director Thaddeus Strassberger is bound to enchant the audience with a colourful show worthy of the finest Carnival celebrations!

results.title: Dys-Sympathetic
results.overview: A dejected man living in Los Angeles limps through a prolonged break-up and the distractions in the aftermath. Brian Follmer directs “Dys-Sympathetic,” a satirical featurette poking at casual sex, casual romance, and the emotional deterioration of it all. Tyler waits for his ex-girlfriend, Zoe, at a bar. We listen to his train-of-thought in the form of narration. He thinks about all the fake food he’s recently eaten and considers what he'll say about himself on his new Tinder profile. After hooking up once again, Tyler and Zoe try returning to “no-contact.” As Tyler begins a numbing, sex-induced bender, Zoe comes by his apartment, wanting more and sharing the news that she’s pregnant. Tyler acquires abortion pills, and the two experience it together at his place.

results.title: Stuffed
results.overview: Araminta, a brooding, dubiously ethical taxidermist, secretly desires to stuff a human specimen. She finds her perfect match in Bernie, a sandwich factory worker whose life is all but memorable. The two decide to go ahead with the plan, but not before they find each other (and various other dead things) in the process.

results.title: Faisha Gesi
results.overview: Urban taxi driver Mahin has just one day to arrange a large sum of money. But as he encounters a series of unexpected incidents during his rides, what will Mahin do to achieve his goal?

results.title: Godari Gattupaina
results.overview: In the picturesque Godavari villages, a kind-hearted auto driver and a spirited college girl fall in love, but their bond is tested by her father's expectations and unforeseen challenges.

results.title: Biff the Human Slayer
results.overview: A delusional vampire takes it upon himself to rid his town of violence. To do so, he teams up with a couple of freshly turned vampires, a stubborn christian struggling to adjust to his new truth, and a rook who is quick to adapt to hers.

results.title: How To Fund A Feature Film (As A Broke College Kid)
results.original_title: How To Fund A Feature Film (As A Broke College Kid)
results.overview: Desperate to fund her dream film, Ava, a broke college student, devises a risky plan to pawn school equipment and flip party drugs over the holiday break. Dragging her best friend, Liam along for the ride.  Inspired by a true story, How To Fund A Feature Film (As A Broke College Kid) is an original crime/comedy short film written and directed by Evan Moore.  It is an independent narrative short film blending crime, comedy, and drama.  It showcases the ambition and questionable decision-making of young filmmakers chasing impossible dreams, the film explores friendship, desperation, and the unintended consequences of trying to shortcut success.

results.title: The Nation
results.overview: A First Nation Chief develops radical ideas about sovereignty.

results.title: May Day x 4
results.overview: Drawing on archival footage from four separate film productions that documented the protests of early May, 1970, this short film creates a kaleidoscopic portrait of the response to the New Haven Black Panther trials.

results.title: Our Loves
results.overview: Based on true events. The story of 7 characters whose lives will unknowingly entangle. Each character is trapped in a failed relationship due to both tragic and comedic events, which leads them all to a shared belief: October 6th, the day the love died, is their worst day ever. The following day, during Hamas' sudden attack on Israel, they'll desperately have to try to survive while figuring out the true meaning of their lives and what must be changed.

results.title: Revolutionary America
results.overview: The story of the American Founding, the greatest political achievement in history. The American colonists had developed a unique way of life as they practiced self-government for 150 years. In the struggles between the colonies and the mother country that followed the French and Indian War, Britain declared that Americans had no right to rule themselves. This went against everything the Americans knew. In response, our ancestors risked their “lives, fortunes, and sacred honor” to fight the War for Independence. Against all odds, they won, and in victory formed a stable, lasting republic.
